scientific.integrity: The proof normalizes the scalar AdaGrad-Norm recurrence to a parameter-free two-state system. Accumulator boundedness is proved directly; the terminal stability window follows by contradiction, and sharpness is witnessed by explicit endpoint-approaching families.
limitations: The theorem is deterministic and one-dimensional.
The terminal accumulator is history dependent and is not expressed in closed form for arbitrary initial data.
The endpoint result ranges over initializations and hyperparameters, not a single fixed run.
Persistent stochastic noise generally prevents convergence to a finite terminal accumulator.

title: Sharp terminal-step window and rate nonuniformity for scalar AdaGrad-Norm
